title: Explorer keeps every render in its .cache: an 8-candidate run grew to 3.8 GB and tripped the disk guard
description: 2026-09-27, renders/explore/lounge-swap (ave-house, --role bright, 8 candidates, 2 workers): the run's .cache reached 3.8 GB (full-song wavs + stems per evaluation) and safe-run killed it at < 3 GB free during stage 2. Stage 1 finished. Same failure as the optimizer's before its fix (scripts/optimize.py _delete_render_cache + chunked L1). Fix: after scoring each evaluation, delete its wav and stems (keep check.json), keep only the incumbent's baseline render, and chunk parallel renders. Test: peak run-dir size stays under ~1 GB for 8 candidates.
